title: Conditions of the Out-of-Network Referral — Referrals & Prior Authorizations
content:
An Out-of-Network Referral, one of the Referrals & Prior Authorizations types, is requested only when a network gap is documented. A network gap exists when the nearest in-network provider of the specialty is farther than the type's network-gap distance from the patient's mailing ZIP code, or when the first in-network appointment is more than the type's network-gap wait away.

## Conditions

1. **Network gap.** Either measure alone establishes the gap; a patient who wants an out-of-network provider without a network gap is not eligible for this type.
2. **Cost-share acknowledgement.** Before submission the patient must sign the cost-share acknowledgement, which only the patient can give, so it is the patient's own act.
3. **Billing.** An approved out-of-network referral is billed by the outside provider under the payer's in-network cost share.
4. **Telehealth.** Telehealth visits with that outside provider do not use the referral's units.

## Network gap truth table

| Nearest in-network provider farther than the gap distance | First in-network appointment further away than the gap wait | Network gap | Eligible for the Out-of-Network Referral on this condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | documented | yes |
| yes | no | documented | yes |
| no | yes | documented | yes |
| no | no | none | no |

The distance is measured from the patient's mailing ZIP code; the wait is to the first in-network appointment.
